narrative.freezing: Near-freezing temperatures in {{location}}. Most species are dormant. A warming trend would change things quickly.
narrative.tooWarm: It is warm in {{location}}. Conditions favour plants and summer berries over fungi, which tend to retreat in the heat.
narrative.flushPattern: Flush pattern active in {{location}}: wet spell 7-10 days ago followed by drier recent days at {{temp}}°C and {{humidity}}% humidity. Exactly the sequence the scoring algorithm rewards most{{catSuffix}}.
narrative.wellAligned: Conditions well-aligned in {{location}}: {{cumRain}}mm over the past two weeks, {{temp}}°C, high humidity. Temperature, humidity and rain are all working in your favour{{catSuffix}}.
narrative.rainScarce: Temperatures are right in {{location}} but rain is the bottleneck, only {{cumRain}}mm over the past two weeks. Well below the 20mm most species need to score well.
narrative.rainOkTempWrong: Rain is adequate in {{location}} ({{cumRain}}mm recently) but temperature ({{temp}}°C) is the main drag. It carries the highest weight in the scoring.
narrative.rainOkHumidLow: Rain and temperature are both reasonable in {{location}}, but humidity is low ({{humidity}}%). The second-highest weight in the algorithm and a significant drag on scores right now.
narrative.slowMissing: Slow period in {{location}}: {{missing}}. Scores should pick up when conditions improve.
narrative.slowSeasonal: Slow period in {{location}}. Weather is reasonable but scores are low, which can happen outside peak season.
narrative.rainBare: Barely any rain in {{daysLabel}}, only {{totalRain}} mm total.
narrative.scorePeakNow: Scores are at their highest point in {{daysLabel}}{{climbSuffix}}.
narrative.scorePeakFalling: Peak conditions were {{peakStr}} and scores are now falling. Act soon or wait for the next rain cycle.
narrative.scorePeakPast: Best window in this period was {{peakStr}}.
narrative.scoreMomentumUp: Scores are on the rise. Conditions may be heading into a better window.
narrative.windStrong: Strong winds (avg {{wind}} m/s). Factor this in if heading into exposed terrain.
narrative.pressureFalling: Pressure is falling. Rain may be on the way.
narrative.pressureRising: Pressure is rising. Rain unlikely, skies should clear.
narrative.diversityWide: A wide variety of species are active{{catSuffix}}.
narrative.diversityGood: A good number of species worth seeking out{{catSuffix}}.
narrative.diversityFew: A handful of species worth seeking out{{catSuffix}}.
